{{Quote|Givin-Paigun probability calculus suggests eighty-six percent odds. I ran the numbers myself.|Watcher Two|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Givin-Paigun probability calculus''' was a type of probability determination calculus developed by members of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] and [[Paigun]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] was capable of performing calculations using Givin-Paigun calculus.
